style: cinematic 3D animation, Pixar-quality rendering, deadpan satire, bright daylight restaurant aquarium, camera always moving, tight to the glass
camera: close on the glass, moving only on physical events — claw slam, tail flick, pay slip drop or throw, body turn; arcs with the turn on the first speech beat, push-in on the second; pulls back wide at 9.0
character: large red-orange lobster, chipped carapace, stalked eyes, antennae, heavy crusher claw, slender cutter claw, weary deadpan, walks not swims, same every beat
cast: a CROWD of tiny crayfish, dozens of them, streaming between his legs in a wave; a SHARK that only appears at 9.0, snatches the bottle overhead and is gone with one tail flick
props: PAY SLIP: small, in the crusher claw. BOTTLE OF WINE: dark green, pops up out of the sand at 7.4 and stays in the air, bobbing just out of reach until the shark takes it
environment: restaurant lobster tank, clear water, pale sand, seaweed, wall price tag, window daylight
lighting: bright natural window daylight, clean, even, high-key, clear water, no shadows on the sand, a sharp glint of light on the wet carapace and a ripple-light flicker on the glass at the claw slam

audio.voice: @Voice: Sadachbia, male, low warm chest voice ~130 Hz, dry and calm
audio.delivery: dry, weary deadpan, native Russian, no accent, even conversational pace
audio.pacing: even pace, 4-5 syllables per second, both lines finish with room to spare
audio.lip_sync: mandibles and mouthparts open clearly on every syllable, voice from the animal, never a voice over

timeline.a: HOOK, silent: claw slams flat on glass, body rocks back, antennae snap forward, tail flicks down kicking sand, ripples cross the glass
silent: crusher claw pulls the pay slip from under his tail, presses it flat to glass; cutter claw smooths it twice; mouth parts at the end, into speech

timeline.line: Мой панцирь крепкий, но зарплата — просто дно.
timeline.a: he pivots his whole body in a slow quarter-turn against the glass as he speaks, camera arcing with him; tail drags a wide sand fan crossing the frame; crusher claw keeps the pay slip pressed to the glass, mandibles open clearly on every syllable
silent: a fish sweeps right past the lens, close and huge, wiping the frame; he is left small behind it

timeline.line: С ней не купить ни рака, ни вино!
timeline.a: same sentence, no breath. He hurls the pay slip at the lens — it sails across the whole frame and flutters away; both claws fly open wide as the shell, and he rears up until his body fills the frame
silent: the camera drops to the sand in one move, looking up at him from below; he stands over the lens, claws still open
silent: a CROWD of tiny crayfish floods between his legs in a wave, dozens of them; he snaps at them again and again and catches nothing, claws clacking shut on water
silent: the wine bottle pops out of the sand and floats up past his face; he lunges and snaps both claws at it, misses every time, the bottle bobbing higher
silent finale: a shark sweeps in overhead, takes the bottle in its mouth and is gone with one hard tail flick; he stands alone in the settling sand, claws still open, deadpan into the lens

must_appear: his body turning with a sand cloud crossing the frame at 1.6-4.3; the pay slip flying across the whole frame at 4.6; a fish wiping past the lens at 4.3; a crowd of crayfish at 7.4; the bottle out of reach at 8.2; the shark taking it at 9.0
negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, English speech, foreign accent, static pose while speaking, floating props, a second bottle, a second lobster, object duplication, extra limbs, multiple characters, character changing mid-shot, night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low key, voice over, silent mouth, cuts, the lobster catching a crayfish, the lobster catching the bottle, the shark staying in frame
